attackers_goals: Attackers may seek to access FTP resources to exfiltrate data, stage attack tools or create a command and control channel through a trusted service.
description: A rare or new FTP user has been detected on an existing FTP server.
investigative_actions: Verify that the new username is legitimate.* Examine the legitimacy of the application that produced this uncommon FTP. Examine the parent process of this application. Check the logs on the FTP server for a new user creation.
name: A rare FTP user has been detected on an existing FTP server
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
